messages.text: I’ll review the pinned endcap implementation and its cryostat, service, HCAL and forward interfaces, then check the barrel corrections in the named parent revision. I’ll keep source checks separate from the coordinator’s native rerun.

The barrel corrections are present: unsupported packing changes are guarded, the electrical loop is 40 m, and the bandwidth scenario uses hits and payload bits. The endcap’s boards and cooling tubes occupy separate axial regions. Its rear support is a full annular material proxy, so the sensor-to-board route through that support needs an explicit limitation.

All 10 endcap tests and all 12 parent-barrel tests pass from the pinned Git blobs. An independent separating-axis check found no overlap among 139,128 board pairs in one repeated endcap plane. The tubes clear the last board plane by 6 mm and the rear cold wall by 59 mm. The main clarification is to describe the full rear support plate, its missing openings and its unmodelled connections to the wheel supports as prototype limitations.

Reviewed **`44ddd54aef096cff9d019dd6b9ee55c06f7b9d7b`** under **LAYOUT002-SysArch-endcap-review**, and barrel remediation at **`5f8c505e26f0f325f17d801583042849f06f62a2`**. No files changed, native jobs, installs or sign-off. I previously supplied layout inputs; this is a separate implementation assessment, with shared design provenance.

**No P1 default-placement defect found in the bounded checks.** Two clarifications remain:

- **P2 — Declare the rear support’s physical approximation and blocked interfaces explicitly.** [endcap_services.py:26]([redacted] [DES-033:97]([redacted] The model uses a continuous, unported **30 mm Al annulus, R400–2800**, occupying \(|z|=5470–5500\), with **1.953598 t per endcap**. The source uses rings and spokes. The full plate blocks direct electrode-to-board paths; wheel-support tubes stop at5460, leaving a10 mm gap to it. Document this as a new conservative material proxy with **support openings, attachments and signal/HV passages absent**, rather than implying source mechanical topology or a preserved support mass. An explicit limitation is sufficient for this isolated prototype; engineered routing remains future work. [Pinned source mechanical-support construction](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/blob/e1ba7bc3e0d7291ebe3f6a02abfa784f879e36cb/detector/calorimeter/ECalEndcap_Turbine_o1_v03_geo.cpp#L540)

- **P3 — HCAL prose still calls total depth “sampling thickness.”** [DES-033:51]([redacted] **1495.9 mm includes1485.9 mm sampling plus10 mm cover**. The parent configuration now correctly uses `hcal_total_depth_mm`; align this sentence before detailed HCAL work to avoid adding the cover twice.

Barrel corrections are verified:

- All eight unsupported packing amendments are now rejected, including board face/depth/pitch, ring widths and pipe ID/OD.
-40 m supply-plus-return loop reproduces **1.194444 V drop and103.684414 W/station**.
- Trigger/hit-rate and64-bit hit-payload naming replaces waveform sample-rate attribution.
-100 mm utility bend records **639.403 mm centreline-plus-clearance** and **739.403 mm inflated envelope**; the rear turn is470 mm.800/500 mm allocations pass.
- Source/prototype steel-gap statements are separated; adverse heat, warm converter placement and missing thermal contacts are explicit.
- Deprecated bandwidth and HCAL sampling-depth keys are absent.

Actual independent checks:

| Check | Result |
|---|---:|
| Exact-blob endcap standard-library tests | **10 passed** |
| Exact-parent barrel tests | **12 passed** |
| Board separating-axis comparisons, one repeated plane | **139128 pairs; zero overlaps** |
| Analytic endcap ledger, both ends | **139.557395167 t** |
| Boards per endcap / hypothetical capacity | **1584 /811008 channels** |
| Board maximum corner radius | **2565.976 mm**, inside2800 mm bath |
| Board axial intervals, positive end | **5500–5535;5545–5580;5590–5625 mm** |
| Radial exchanger centreline endpoints | **R420–2775 mm** |
| Exchanger axial envelope | **5631–5651 mm** |
| Last board → exchanger clearance | **6 mm** |
| Exchanger → outer bath clearance | **24.982 mm** |
| Exchanger → rear cold wall clearance | **59 mm** |

These calculations used pinned source and data blobs loaded in memory, without generating files. Board planes repeat the checked transverse arrangement and have10 mm axial separations. Signed-end transforms and enclosure/displacement conservation passed the existing controls.

HCAL and forward checks reproduce the documented values:

- HCAL barrel volume **432.757 m³**, versus224.783 m³; each endcap101.009 versus66.489 m³. Combined outline growth **×1.774301**, without an installed-mass inference.
- HCAL barrel/endcap maximum corner radii are **4716.527/4706.331 mm**; apothems remain distinct from circular LAr radii.
- Endcap any-intersection envelope: **1.34835–3.28360**; full-depth annular envelope: **1.42423–3.19785**. These are geometric bounds, with partial-depth barrel/endcap transitions retained.
- Anη4 ray reaches **287.868 mm** at the FCal reservation’s rear edge, leaving only **2.132 mm** radial margin. The unassigned technology and downstream beam/machine interfaces remain open.

Retain the stated scope limits:1584 slots per endcap exceed the650k-channel cable/power planning allowance; full slot population is not fully resourced merely by having material proxies. At60 mW/channel it requires **48.66048 kW/endcap**, exceeding40 kW before static heat. Headers, hydraulic returns, wall/support openings, thermal contacts and external routing graphs remain absent. The empty service and forward reservations are correctly distinguished from installed hardware.

The coordinator’s exact-revision native rerun was still pending during this assessment. **139.557395 t above is my analytic recomputation; I did not independently run or certify the native overlap result.**
